title: Cardstock pack rule tests (v0)
description: Table-driven rule tests: given an exact constructed state, assert move legality, apply moves, and check scores/state. Run by tools/pack-test.mjs. Zone addressing: shared zones by id ('discard', 'build.2'); per-player zones with the seat as the LAST segment ('hand.2' = seat 2's hand; 'discard.1.0' = pile 1 of seat 0). Seats are 0-indexed. Card lists are ordered bottom-first — the LAST id is the top of the pile. Duplicate physical cards use instance ids '<id>#2', '<id>#3', …

variants.description: Variant ids active for every test in this file.

zones.description: zone address → ordered card ids (bottom-first, last = top).

vars.description: Game vars (template-defined names, e.g. activeSuit, heartsBroken, led, leader, trickNumber).

playerVars.description: seat → { var: value } (e.g. Milestones' phase / laidDown).

unlisted.description: Where deck cards not placed by 'zones' go: shuffled into the draw pile, or removed from play.

oneOf.description: Legality check — does not mutate state.

rule.description: When legal:false, the id of the rule expected to reject it.

oneOf.description: Apply a move (must be legal) to advance state within the test.
Make an announcement or a challenge, e.g. {actor, id} or {actor, challenge, target}.
Run the pack's round scorer over the current state; compare per-seat.
Partial state match. 'zones' values may be an exact ordered id list or an integer count. Other keys: vars, playerVars, turn, direction, scores, gameOver, winner.

type.description: Template move types, e.g. playCard, draw, discard, layDown, hit, passCards.

choice.description: Free-form move payload: chosen suit/color/player, laydown melds, hit target, …
